referenceDefiningTraits: Asymmetrically tilted rectangular paper sheets with visibly displaced flat shadows and layered offset edges.
Large overlapping central composition combines a repeated arch pattern with a bold typographic sheet; patterned paper remains visible above and below the label.
Thin curved merging arrows and a folded-corner output document create a handmade paper-process narrative.
Expressive scale and rotation differences, spare broad background, and light/dark translations preserve the same composition.

applicableOverrides.font: Noto Sans CJK JP/sans-serif replaces reference Latin serif typography; serif absence is not scored as a loss.
applicableOverrides.palette: Common six-role palette overrides reference colors; reference hue differences are not scored as losses.
applicableOverrides.brief: Literal Pattern/Text/MAKE/PNG labels and that reference workflow are not requirements.

images.viewMethod: view_image; native raster presented in conversation
observations: Three large, slightly tilted paper cards read left to right: application, waiting, confirmation. Solid arrows establish the sequence.
The waiting card explicitly says まだ確定していません. The confirmed card says 変更が使えます. The change card connects from confirmed back into waiting, and explanatory text states no automatic approval.
Strong state labels, smaller supporting copy, and generous separation give a clear hierarchy. The return arrow and change label do not collide.

images.viewMethod: view_image; native raster presented in conversation
observations: Three wide tilted cards stack vertically. The preparation and confirmation role labels each wrap over two lines without dropping characters. The reception role remains complete on one line.

consistency.reason: Shared pale field, white skewed papers, modest offset shadows, short colored header bars, bold Japanese labels, and semantic color roles are coherent. Horizontal, grid, stacked, parallel, and portrait structures remain distinct and fit their ratios.

character.reason: The batch is a recognizable paper-card interpretation, but the original’s defining patterned, overlapping construction is reduced to clean independent cards. Required font and palette overrides do not account for that geometry/texture loss.
